KB16.title: IMD Agromet Advisory - High Humidity and Dew Precautions
KB16.content: IMD Agromet Warning: Relative humidity exceeding 85% accompanied by moderate day temperatures (28-32°C) and persistent morning dew creates favorable conditions for blast in paddy and fungal leaf spot in cotton and chilli. Farmers are advised to postpone nitrogenous top dressing and inspect fields daily.

KB17.title: Weekly University Advisory on Cotton Sucking Pests and Pink Bollworm
KB17.content: PJTSAU Advisory: Sucking pest pressure (jassids and thrips) expected to rise due to intermittent dry spells. If jassids exceed 1-2 per leaf, spray Flonicamid 50 WG @ 60g/acre. For pink bollworm, continue pheromone monitoring and install light traps.

KB18.title: Cotton and Chilli Agmarknet Mandi Prices & MSP
KB18.content: Warangal Enumamula Agricultural Market Yard: Medium Staple Cotton Minimum Support Price (MSP) is ₹7,121/quintal; Long Staple MSP is ₹7,521/quintal. Current modal market rate for fair average quality (FAQ) cotton with moisture < 12% is ₹7,450 - ₹7,800/quintal. Teja variety dry red chilli trading at ₹16,500 - ₹18,200/quintal.
KB18.citation: Agmarknet Portal, Directorate of Marketing & Inspection (DMI) 2025

KB19.title: ZARS Warangal Crop Variety Recommendations
KB19.content: Zonal Agricultural Research Station (ZARS) Warangal recommends Bt cotton hybrids with tolerance to leaf reddening (such as RCH-659, Mallika, Jaadoo). For rice, gall midge resistant varieties (Telangana Sona / RNR-15048 with low GI, KNM-118, Siddhi) are recommended for both Kharif and Rabi.
KB19.citation: ZARS Warangal Regional Agricultural Research Station 2025
